scripts.dev: pnpm --filter shared build && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
